sources.name: SEC EDGAR

licence.name: SEC.gov website dissemination policy
licence.summary: Information on sec.gov is public information and may be copied or further distributed; the SEC asks for citation as the source and forbids use of its seal and logos. Resale is not addressed, so it is not treated as granted.
licence.attribution: Source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, EDGAR.
licence.exceptions: The SEC cannot guarantee the accuracy of the financial statement data sets; they do not replace the filings.

rate_limit.documented: No more than 10 requests per second in total, regardless of the number of machines; the SEC may limit request rates and block IP addresses that submit excessive requests.

request_rules: Declare a User-Agent with an organisation name and a contact email; the app refuses to start downloads without MULTIVERSE_SEC_USER_AGENT containing '@'.
Download only what is needed: history from bulk files, not API loops.
One request at a time through a token bucket of 2 requests per second for the whole process.
No crawling of sec.gov pages; only the documented API and bulk file addresses.
sources.retry_policy: Retry only 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504, at most 3 times, with exponential backoff from 10 seconds plus jitter and Retry-After when sent. Stop the whole run on 403: it means the access policy was violated.
sources.checksum_policy: The SEC publishes no checksums for these files, so MULTIVERSE computes SHA-256 on receipt, stores it with Last-Modified and ETag, and never overwrites a raw file: a changed file is a new snapshot.

risks.title: Unsupported region or accounting standard
risks.description: Foreign private issuers file 20-F or 40-F, often under IFRS, and companyfacts mixes ifrs-full and us-gaap facts.
risks.mitigation: V2 accepts domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers reporting in USD under US GAAP; others are shown as unsupported with the reason (decision D-04).
risks.detection: Form types and taxonomy per company in the coverage report.

risks.title: Survivorship bias
risks.description: A universe built from today's tickers drops acquired, merged and bankrupt companies and makes history look better.
risks.mitigation: Build the universe from historical filers by CIK, including companies without a current ticker; the first ten include one acquired company.
risks.detection: Coverage report counts companies whose filings stop, by year.

risks.title: Missing or changing XBRL tags
risks.description: R&D is not tagged separately by many filers, extension tags are absent from companyfacts, and concepts change, for example revenue concepts after ASC 606.
risks.mitigation: An ordered concept map per metric with the concept used in the lineage; a missing value stays missing, never zero.
risks.detection: Coverage by company, metric and quarter; concept switches flagged.

risks.title: Quarterization errors
risks.description: 10-Q income and cash-flow values are often year-to-date; Q4 exists only as FY minus nine months; 52/53-week years shift period ends.
risks.mitigation: Reconstruct quarters from start, end and duration (qtrs), derive Q4 only when definitions match, never quarterize balance sheet instants; the first ten have calendar fiscal years.
risks.detection: Unit tests on YTD fixtures; quarters summing to the fiscal year (DATA-03).

risks.title: Restatements and amendments
risks.description: The same period is reported again in 10-K/A or recast after discontinued operations; companyfacts keeps several values for one period.
risks.mitigation: Keep every value with its accession and filing date; original, vintage and latest views; point-in-time picks the latest value filed before the cutoff.
risks.detection: Count of periods with more than one value; differences above a threshold.

risks.title: Time to publication and leakage
risks.description: A quarter ends weeks before its filing; macro data are revised; FRED gives release dates without a time of day.
risks.mitigation: Knowledge time is the acceptance time of the filing; macro values count from the day after release unless the release time is documented.
risks.detection: A deliberately future-dated fixture must stay invisible (DATA-02).

risks.title: Currency, unit and scale errors
risks.description: Facts come in several units (USD, other currencies, shares, USD per share); a company may change reporting currency; tagging errors shift magnitudes.
risks.mitigation: Unit allowlist per metric; non-USD values are not converted in V2; jumps of an order of magnitude against neighbouring quarters are flagged.
risks.detection: Unit and magnitude checks in normalization (DATA-04).

risks.title: Ticker and name changes
risks.description: Tickers are reused by other companies; submissions show only current tickers.
risks.mitigation: CIK is the key; ticker and name histories are dated (contracts 0.2.0).
risks.detection: Search by a former ticker resolves to the right CIK and dates.

risks.title: Segment and co-registrant values mixed with consolidated ones
risks.description: Data set rows can belong to a segment or a co-registrant.
risks.mitigation: Use only rows with empty segments and co-registrant for consolidated values.
risks.detection: Totals compared with companyfacts for the same accession.

risks.title: Terms of use and redistribution
risks.description: FRED third-party series need permission; ECB statistics must stay unmodified; some World Bank indicators belong to third parties; free access is not resale.
risks.mitigation: Licence and terms version stored with every raw file; raw bytes never committed; per-series check of FRED notes and World Bank metadata; attribution shown.
risks.detection: Catalog tests: every source has terms, key status and resale status.

risks.title: Access blocked by the provider
risks.description: Exceeding SEC fair access or an invalid FRED key blocks requests; an IP block stops every job.
risks.mitigation: Token bucket at 2 requests per second, declared User-Agent enforced by settings, bulk files for history, stop on 403.
risks.detection: Request log with status codes; a 403 fails the run.

risks.title: Errors in the source data
risks.description: The SEC does not guarantee the accuracy of extracted data; XBRL facts can have wrong signs or scale.
risks.mitigation: Accounting identity checks (assets equal liabilities plus equity), sign checks, anomaly flags shown in the dossier.
risks.detection: Data quality flags per company and quarter.

risks.title: Macro revisions used as if known
risks.description: Using today's macro values for past dates leaks later revisions.
risks.mitigation: ALFRED vintages, ECB includeHistory, WDI archives; as-of joins only.
risks.detection: Tests compare as-of values with a known vintage.

risks.title: Documentation and endpoints change
risks.description: Providers change endpoints and terms without notice.
risks.mitigation: verified_on per source; documentation re-read before the first download of each source; contract tests on saved sample responses.
risks.detection: Schema validation of every raw response.

risks.title: Volume and storage
risks.description: Quarterly data set files reach 122 MB and notes files 810 MB compressed; history adds up to gigabytes.
risks.mitigation: Start with ten companies through the API; bulk files only after the owner agrees on a disk budget; raw files live in var/ and never in git.
risks.detection: Disk use reported by each run.
